constraints.ocl:
context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 4 and self.amount <= 61

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 7 and self.weightKg <= 43

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 13 and self.amount <= 39

context Airport
inv: self.arrivingFlights->any(x | x.flightNo <> '') <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null

context Booking
inv: (self.payment <> null) and (not(self.payment <> null))

context BoardingPass
inv: (self.seat <> null) and (not(self.seat <> null))

context Payment
inv: ((self.booking <> null) and (self.booking.oclIsTypeOf(Booking))) and (not((self.booking <> null) and (self.booking.oclIsTypeOf(Booking))))

context Airline
inv: (self.aircrafts->any(x | x.model <> '') <> null) and (not(self.aircrafts->any(x | x.model <> '') <> null))

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.seat <> null) and (self.checkIn.booking.bookingRef <> '')) and (not((self.seat <> null) and (self.checkIn.booking.bookingRef <> '')))

context Airline
inv: (self.aircrafts->exists(x | x.model <> '')) and (not(self.aircrafts->exists(x | x.model <> '')))

context Passenger
inv: (self.bookings->collect(x | x.baggages)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.bookings->collect(x | x.baggages)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Aircraft
inv: ((self.seats->collect(x | x.seatNo)->notEmpty()) and (self.seats->size() > 0)) and (not((self.seats->collect(x | x.seatNo)->notEmpty()) and (self.seats->size() > 0)))
